_howto: To add a city: upload <city>.html to the repo root, then add one block to the 'trips' list below. Nothing else needs changing.

_fields.country: required — the home page groups by month, then by country
_fields.dates: text shown on the card, e.g. '18-19 August 2026'
_fields.start: YYYY-MM-DD — sorts the list and sets the month group
_fields.file: the html file in this repo, e.g. 'khiva.html'
_fields.hotel: where you stayed — shown on the card
_fields.accent: hex colour for the card stripe (brand teal #0F4C5C, coral #FF7A59)

trips.blurb: The old town west to east, from the oldest building in Central Asia to the last emir's world.
Shah-i-Zinda on the doorstep, the Registan at opening, Timur's tomb before noon, and Ulugh Beg's observatory on the last morning.
The metro as a museum, Chorsu under its blue dome, the world's oldest Qur'an, and the squares of the rebuilt city.
